Sam S: Heads-up — TelosPay onboarding blocked: they tried to invite 120 seats but org cap is 100. Onboarding flow errors out. Renewal in ~30d, flagging to CS for priority handling.
Anika R: Thanks. Quick Q: are they on a paid plan or trial? Who's the billing contact?
Jordan P: Trial (no billing yet). Ticket #3421 created with repro and logs. Link: https://tickets.internal/3421. Error returned is `quota_exceeded`.
Sam S: They started a POC with 80 seats, then decided to scale to 120 before SSO was finished. This left the admin stuck. Customer is frustrated.
Priya M: @Anika R I can intro to their CTO (Elena Moreno) and offer a short promo if we extend capacity. Renewal negotiation is in 30d — this stall ups the risk.
Anika R: Proposed comms & triage plan:
1) CS owner: Anika R (primary contact to CTO)
2) Support owner: Jordan P (ticket & logs)
3) Ops: temporary seat cap increase to 150 for 14 days while SSO + onboarding finished
4) AM (Priya) to lead renewal mitigation message and promo offer
Agree?
ops-bot: Provisioning request queued: increase seat cap for org `telospay-prod` -> 150 for 14 days. Request ID req-8842.
Jordan P: Repro steps in ticket: `POST /orgs/telospay/seats` payload `{ \"count\": 120 }` => 403 `quota_exceeded`. Working on config patch; ETA ~6h.
Anika R: Action items (owners):
- Priya M: send CTO intro + limited promo (today)
- ops: expedite req-8842 (cap -> 150 for 14d)
- Jordan P: patch/config fix (6h)
- Anika R: run 1:1 onboarding admin session tomorrow AM
Priya M: I'll send the intro + promo by EOD and loop Anika.
Sam S: Adding risk note: renewal currently ~$120k ARR. If onboarding stalls we estimate ~30% churn risk. Marking this P0->high priority for CS + AM.
Anika R: Scheduling a 30-min onboarding sync for tomorrow 10:00am PT with their admin + CTO if available. If cap lift isn't completed after Jordan's ETA, we'll escalate to eng on-call.
Jordan P: Patch deployed to staging, running validation tests now. Will post updates in ticket. /me fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
Anika R: :thumbsup: Please update this thread when ops completes req-8842 and when we have CTO reply. I'll prepare a short onboarding checklist to send after the cap lift.
ops-bot: Request req-8842 completed: cap increased to 150. Completed by ops-user at 2024-11-05T15:23:00Z.
